/scripts.value:
command calculateWidthForProgress
	local tCompletionList, tTotalCompletion, tCurrentCompletion
	
	//put cdb_list("LiveQuizParticipants", "cloud", "completion", liveQuizParticipantIDs) into tCompletionList
	put 0 into tTotalCompletion
	
	repeat for each line xCompletion in completionList
		put xCompletion into tCurrentCompletion
		delete char -1 of tCurrentCompletion
		add tCurrentCompletion to tTotalCompletion
	end repeat
	
	if tTotalCompletion is not 0 and tTotalCompletion is a number then
		put(tTotalCompletion/the number of lines of completionList)/100 into percentComplete
	end if
	
	put round(percentComplete * progressBgWidth) into progressWidth
end calculateWidthForProgress
